verdict.rationale: Consensus exposes an API and MCP server that cover core retrieval/synthesis functions (search, citations, Consensus Meter, filters, PICO extraction) matching much of the web UI, per docs-16/18/19/22/23/25. However, there's no evidence that UI-specific features like Library import/management, Citation Graph, or Deep Search literature reviews are fully exposed via API, so full UI-API parity is unconfirmed. missing for 10: evidence that Library/reference-manager, Citation Graph, and Deep Search/Lit Review UI features are all accessible via the API/MCP server, and independent confirmation of parity.
